correctness.rationale: Each part has identical external neighborhood; at a genuine temporal two-cycle a changing part must switch uniform opposite bits. One toggler cannot reverse with its other parts static. Two togglers must oppose in phase and have equal sizes p; the static third part remains arbitrary exactly for |2j-r|<p, giving B(p,r). Three togglers are possible in exactly one orbit when a unique part is strictly largest. These cases exhaust all cycles and treat ties strictly. Independently enumerated labelled binary transitions for all 31 sorted size triples 1<=a<=b<=c<=5 with total<=12, including (1,1,1),(1,1,2),(1,1,3), agreeing with the binomial formula. No inference from bounded enumeration to all sizes.
